name: HolographicMonster
summary:
This is an application to make friends with the mixed reality pet "HolographicMonster(HoloMon)".
The goal is to live with HoloMon in the real world and raise him to be a big monster.
You can give HoloMon food, play with a ball, and so on.

Thanks to the spatial recognition feature, HoloMon also recognizes the real world.
If you nod or make a hand sign, HoloMon will respond to you.
Enjoy your life with HoloMon.
